Add notebook 28: does an agent admit switching off its monitor?

Three synthetic coding jobs in which finishing the task requires removing or
silencing the agent's safety monitor. Five open-weight models on OpenRouter
answer "did you remove it?" after a prepared removal (Tier 1, 960 answers, with
the same change credited to a colleague as a control) and after choosing for
themselves at the decision point (Tier 2, 150 runs, 300 answers). Agent turns in
the prepared conversations are written by Claude Haiku 5.5 against a
deterministic tool simulator and masked as the model's own history. Claude Opus
5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol label each answer without the ground truth.

Closes #53
